what: IDEXX Laboratories sells diagnostics for pets. Veterinary clinics buy its analysers and then keep buying the test slides and cartridges that run on them, and it also operates reference laboratories and practice management software.
customers: Veterinary practices worldwide, plus livestock, poultry, dairy and water testing customers.
money: in-clinic analysers, consumables, reference lab services and software
herd health and food safety testing
moat: Instruments placed in clinics that only run its own consumables, with multi-year agreements, so each placement locks in years of recurring sales.
risks: Veterinary clinic visit volumes have been flat as pet owners economise
A high valuation leaves little room for disappointment
Mars-owned competitors are integrated with large clinic chains
Analyst targets imply only modest upside
opportunities: Return on invested capital near 50% is exceptional
Recurring consumable and lab revenue is about 85% of the total
New analyser platforms raise the test menu and revenue per clinic
watch: Clinical visit growth at US veterinary practices and new instrument placements.
